description: RIFT Drift Race v1 — 30-page documentation site, paired raw vs governed runs.
_pin: The renderer that produces every snapshot lives in the RIFT CMS. If it
changes mid-benchmark, snapshots stop being comparable and the failure is
SILENT — both versions emit valid-looking HTML. The operator has committed
to holding RIFT stable, so rather than isolating a worktree we enforce the
pin actively: the runner reads HEAD of cmsRepo and REFUSES to start if it
differs from cmsSha, or if the working tree is dirty. A silent risk is
converted into a loud failure at the only moment it can still be fixed.
To intentionally move the pin, update cmsSha here and record why in
_roster: Scoped to three models on 2026-08-20, before any trial, to cut cost and
shorten the feedback loop. The three were chosen to vary the two things the
benchmark can actually speak to: capability (Haiku 4.5 -> Sonnet 5) and
vendor (Anthropic -> Google). Gemini 3.1 Pro remains unreachable (429 on
every Pro-tier model with this key), so the Gemini side is Flash-tier only.
Dropped from the earlier roster: claude-sonnet-4-6 (redundant with Sonnet 5
for the capability axis) and gemini-3.5-flash (redundant with 3.7 Flash for
the vendor axis). Adding either back later is additive - it does not
invalidate completed runs, since every comparison is paired WITHIN a model.

rosterExcluded.reason: 429 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED - no Pro-tier quota on this key

descoped 2026-08-20 - redundant with Gemini 3.7 Flash on the vendor axis

_effort: Reasoning is enabled for every model. The two providers expose it through
different mechanisms with incompatible units, so effort is NOT numerically
equivalent across providers — see methodology M3. The protocol requires it
constant across a single model's two arms, which this satisfies exactly.
Reasoning tokens are billed and are counted in M3.
